ars_ingressum.glyph_desc.glyph_stalwart: Turns the target into an immovable guardian. Grants increased damage and knockback reduction at the cost of slower movement speed.
ars_ingressum.glyph_desc.glyph_alacrity: Grants increased overall speed to the target. Beware the lethargic backlash once the spell ends.
ars_ingressum.glyph_desc.glyph_empower: Grants increased physical strength for melee attacks and jumping power to the target.
ars_ingressum.glyph_desc.glyph_bless: Grants increasing healing to the target for the duration.
ars_ingressum.glyph_desc.glyph_invigorat: Passively recovers target's hunger and saturation.
ars_ingressum.glyph_desc.glyph_false_lif: Grants faux vitality to the target for a short duration.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_stalwart_: Increases damage and knockback resistance at the cost of even slower movement.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_alacrity_: Increases overall speed at the cost of a harsher backlash when the spell ends.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_empower_g: Increases melee damage, knockback, and jumping strength.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_bless_gly: Amplifies incoming healing to the target.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_invigorat: Amplifies the target's passive hunger and saturation recovery.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_false_lif: Increases the amount of temporary health granted.
ars_ingressum.page.vacant_tuning_fork: A Tuning Fork serves as a guide when traveling through dimensions. Attune a vacant Fork to a desired dimension using the Imbuement Chamber, or by right-clicking a Planarium. Reattuning an already attuned Tuning Fork will also replenish its uses.
ars_ingressum.ritual_desc.ritual_plane_s: Teleports all nearby entities to their approximate coordinates at a different dimension. Before starting the ritual, you must first augment the ritual with an attuned Tuning Fork to set the destination. The ritual will fail if no nearby safe coordinates are found at the destination, or the destination is the same as the origin.
ars_ingressum.tuning_fork.planarium_dim_: The selected Planarium doesn't hold a pocket dimension inside it. Try creating one first...
chat.ars_ingressum.attuning.attuning_sta: Attuning. Add source nearby to increase attuning speed.
